explanation: deploy:cf now runs prepare:deploy first: it fetches the query catalog from the data origin, the tracker catalog and any missing or incomplete GTEx/HPA/Allen atlas, keeps complete local atlases, and stops when local query pointers differ from the origin (--refresh-query takes them). verify:release then fails if dist/ lacks an atlas file or the tracker catalog, and verify:deploy checks the live site serves them. upload:bundles refuses bundles restored from the public data release (fetch:data marker, KEGG note, empty macaque cpm, all-empty KEGG corpus) in every mode unless --allow-reduced-bundles. delivery.md no longer claims a scientific prebuild or tracked atlas inputs. vite.config.ts differs from the private source only by its test exclusions.
